description.text: A small set of 21 cards, 20 and a secret Kyurem, released on 5 October 2012 midway through the Black & White series. Every card is a holo Dragon Pokémon or Trainer, Rayquaza and Druddigon among them, and there were no booster boxes: its five-card packs came three to a Dragon Vault box, with a promo and an online code.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets

description.text: A cosmos holofoil copy from an XY Two Pack Blister, released on 5 February 2014. Each blister held two XY booster packs, a coin and three cosmos holofoil cards: Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise, or Dragonite, Garchomp and Hydreigon. The same three came again in the XY Knock Out Collection, first sold in Canada in October 2014. It isn't found in booster packs.
